items.title: Phillips 66 (PSX) Nears Cost Target, Is The Upside Already Priced In?
items.summary: Cost target progress and why it matters for Phillips 66 stock Phillips 66 (PSX) has outlined more than 200 initiatives to reduce refining adjusted controllable costs to about $5.50 per barrel by 2027, with second quarter 2026 costs already at $5.57. This cost focus sits alongside a recent share price of $246.58 and a market cap of about $97.4b.
